summary: Completed E2E testing of Meta (WhatsApp Business API) compliant User Data Deletion Policy feature. All features implemented and working correctly. Fixed routing issue in App.js where legal pages routes were placed after catch-all route.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Routes in App.js - Legal pages routes (lines 382-386) were placed AFTER the catch-all route (line 380). This caused all legal pages to redirect to '/' instead of loading. Moved legal pages routes before the catch-all.
seed_data_creation: None - test data created during API tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meta Data Deletion Policy feature is fully implemented and tested. All routes work correctly after routing fix. Backend endpoints: /api/data-deletion/request, /api/data-deletion/status/{code}, /api/meta/data-deletion-callback are all functional.

footer_links.details: Footer on landing page has links to: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Data Deletion, Contact (mailto)

privacy_policy_page.details: /privacy-policy loads correctly with WhatsApp Business data handling information including: Personal Information, WhatsApp Data, Usage Data sections

data_deletion_page.details: /data-deletion loads with form to submit deletion request. Has phone input, email input, reason textarea, and submit button

submit_deletion_request.details: POST /api/data-deletion/request works with phone and/or email. Returns confirmation code (DEL_*) and status_url

check_deletion_status.details: GET /api/data-deletion/status/{code} returns status (pending/in_progress/completed/failed), confirmation_code, requested_at, message

meta_callback_endpoint.details: POST /api/meta/data-deletion-callback returns Meta-compliant format: {url: string, confirmation_code: string}

data_deletion_status_page.details: /data-deletion-status loads with code query parameter. Shows status or 'Request Not Found' message

backend_tests_summary.TestDataDeletionRequest: 4 tests - submit with phone, email, both, empty fields validation
backend_tests_summary.TestDataDeletionStatus: 2 tests - valid code returns status, invalid code returns 404
backend_tests_summary.TestMetaDataDeletionCallback: 3 tests - callback without/with signed_request, response format validation
backend_tests_summary.TestE2EDataDeletionFlow: 1 test - complete flow submit -> check status

frontend_tests_summary.Test1_FooterLinks: PASS - All 4 links present (Terms, Privacy, Data Deletion, Contact)
frontend_tests_summary.Test2_PrivacyPolicy: PASS - Page loads, has WhatsApp info, header visible
frontend_tests_summary.Test3_DataDeletionForm: PASS - Page loads, phone/email inputs present, submit button works
frontend_tests_summary.Test4_SubmitRequest: PASS - Submission successful, confirmation code displayed
frontend_tests_summary.Test5_StatusPage: PASS - Page loads, shows 'Not Found' for invalid codes
frontend_tests_summary.Test6_CheckStatusUI: PASS - Check Status tab works, can enter code and search

routing_fix_applied.issue: Legal pages routes were placed AFTER catch-all route in App.js
routing_fix_applied.impact: All legal pages (/privacy-policy, /data-deletion, /data-deletion-status, /terms-of-service) were redirecting to '/' instead of loading
routing_fix_applied.fix: Moved legal pages routes (lines 382-386) before the catch-all route (line 380)
